row_rule: Exactly one row for every frozen taxonomy family x dimension pair. No family or dimension may be added, deleted, merged or split after evidence is observed.

anchor_rule.meaning: Anchor must follow the dimension-specific v1.0 verbal anchor exactly. It is not estimated from ARGOS performance or feasibility outcomes.

ecg_rule.A: Direct same-family high-quality evidence plus strong institutional/process support or independent corroboration.
ecg_rule.B: Strong same-family mechanism/evidence with a material directness or coverage limitation.
ecg_rule.D: Insufficient evidence; anchor null; family/dimension unresolved rather than scored low.

source_rule.primary_source_definition: Official institutional/process source or original research paper directly supporting the structural claim.
source_rule.contradiction_rule: Materially contradictory direct evidence must lower ECG or produce D; it may not be omitted to preserve a preferred rank.
source_rule.missing_rule: Missing evidence is D, never anchor 0.

TAW_rule: TAW is scored from the plausible duration of unequal information generated by the event process, not Polymarket contract lead time and not realized lead-lag performance.
PSI_rule: PSI 0 or 1 requires at least two distinct standardized public monitoring/forecast channels documented in the evidence row/rationale.
f1_f9_separation: Frozen PIT-v2.1 F1-F9 outcomes are not IAS magnitude inputs and are not present in the IAS evidence matrix. They are reintroduced only after IAS/SMAA freeze for final W3 GO/NO-GO.
central_index: Arithmetic mean of PAC, LSO, SIB, TAW, PSI anchors only when no ECG-D exists.
evidence_gate: No ECG-D and at least 3 of 5 dimensions ECG-A/B.

value_uncertainty.D: Uniform(0,5), descriptive only; unresolved family excluded from comparative claim

sequencing: freeze protocol + scoring contract + scorer + synthetic validator
only then populate real evidence matrix
only then combine with already-frozen F1-F9 for W3 GO/NO-GO
